# Contributing

## Before you start

Before starting work on a feature, please open an issue to discuss it.
Pull requests from contributors who are not assigned to the linked issue will be closed automatically.
We do not assign issues to drive-by contributors.
You can request that an issue be assigned to you.
When an issue lacks details, the `needs-info` label is assigned.

## Legal

We don't require DCO sign-off. Since we do not have a formal Contributor License Agreement (CLA), you keep your copyright.
All commits must be signed with a GPG or SSH key and show as Verified on GitHub.

## UI

Please attach screenshots or a short recording for any UI change.

## AI

When using AI tools, keep pull requests small and split large generated diffs.
You must run the full test suite locally before opening a PR.
